name: Steel Maiden
description:
About This Game

⚡ Two Buttons. Relentless Speed.

Remember the thrill of cutting down hundreds of enemies with just two fingers? I've reawakened that feeling — and built a roguelite around it.

No tangled controls. Just two buttons standing between you and the horde closing in from every side. Beneath that dead-simple input lies a razor-sharp battle of timing that pushes your reflexes to their absolute limit.

Your hands react before your mind can catch up. Kills erupt across the screen, and the dopamine hits fast. One run in, and "just one more" becomes impossible to resist.

🎨 Directed by an Award-Finalist Eye

The art in this game comes from the art director behind a Steam Awards "Outstanding Visual Style" finalist — that same proven eye, now poured into a single, focused experience.

Every action is brought to life by silky-smooth 2D sprite animation, rendered frame by frame with a touch of retro pixel soul. Every slash, dodge, and takedown unfolds like a moving illustration.

🎲 A New Build Every Run — Roguelite at Its Core

No two runs are ever the same. The builds you choose mid-run completely reshape your abilities, turning every attempt into a fresh fight.

- Weapon Fusion — Combine the weapons you find on a run to unlock entirely new powers.

- Relic Unlocks — Collect and unlock relics between runs to gradually shape your own playstyle.

The real fun begins the moment you discover your perfect build among countless combinations.

👤 Made by One Pair of Hands

Every piece of this — the feel, the fluid animation, the ever-shifting builds — was crafted by a single developer. Experience what one person's obsession can build.
short_desc: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.
